summary: Complaints centre on unpaid sugarcane dues from the Thanabhawan sugar mill, stray cattle damaging crops and roads, and a stalled cremation-ground road, while appreciation is thin and mostly inferred from ongoing road works and administrative follow-up.

positives.english: Road work has started at the bus stand and old bypass, so relief may come soon.
positives.hindi: बस स्टैंड और पुराने बाईपास पर सड़क बन रही है, राहत मिलने की उम्मीद है।
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026) says road construction at the bus stand and old bypass is causing travel trouble, which implies work is underway. The article is a Shamli dateline story and does not name Thanabhawan for this work, so it is district-level.

positives.english: The cremation-ground road has a tender completed, so work is expected to begin.
positives.hindi: श्मशान घाट की सड़क का टेंडर हो चुका है, अब काम शुरू होने का इंतजार है।
positives.basis: Inference: Nayan Jagriti reports the tender for the Thanabhawan cremation-ground road was completed about a year earlier and a contractor was selected, but no work order had been issued as of 22 Aug 2026. The positive is only that the tender process is done; it is not a claim that work has begun.

positives.english: Farmers can raise their demands openly at the district's Kisan Diwas meeting.
positives.hindi: किसान दिवस में किसान अपनी समस्याएं खुलकर अधिकारियों के सामने रख पा रहे हैं।
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026) reports that farmers at the Shamli district Kisan Diwas (held 16 Sep) raised the Thanabhawan mill dues, stray cattle, soil mining, and power line issues. This shows a grievance forum exists, but it is district-level and does not show the outcome.

positives.english: Sugar mill is running this season, so cane has a buyer nearby.
positives.hindi: चीनी मिल चल रही है, इसलिए गन्ने को पास में ही खरीदार मिल जाता है।
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026) describes a district review of the 2025-26 crushing season covering the Thanabhawan mill, and the 2026-27 season is being prepared. This shows the mill operates, but the same article records its dues as unpaid.

positives.english: The district magistrate is pressing sugar mills to clear farmers' dues.
positives.hindi: डीएम ने चीनी मिल को बकाया भुगतान के लिए सख्त चेतावनी दी है।
positives.basis: District Magistrate Alok Yadav expressed displeasure at the Thanabhawan mill's Rs 81.37 crore pending payment and warned of strict action if negligence continues. Shamli and Oon mills were reported as having paid 100% of their dues. This is a district-level administrative action, not a positive on the ground.

negatives.english: Thanabhawan mill still hasn't paid our sugarcane dues.
negatives.hindi: थानाभवन मिल ने अभी तक हमारा गन्ना मूल्य बकाया नहीं दिया है।
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): Rs 81.37 crore cane price payment is still pending at the Thanabhawan sugar mill, per a DM review of the 2025-26 crushing season. Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026) quotes BKU youth district president Prabhat Malik saying the Thanabhawan mill has not paid farmers' dues.

negatives.english: Stray cattle are ruining our crops and we guard the fields all night.
negatives.hindi: आवारा पशु फसल बर्बाद कर रहे हैं, रातभर खेत की रखवाली करनी पड़ती है।
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026), Thanabhawan dateline: stray animals are entering fields in Nozal, Hasanpur, Khanpur, Chandenamal and nearby villages, damaging paddy, sugarcane, maize, jowar and green fodder. Farmers have to guard fields all night.

negatives.english: The road to the cremation ground is mud and waterlogged in rain, and no work has started.
negatives.hindi: श्मशान घाट का रास्ता बारिश में कीचड़ और जलभराव से बदहाल है, काम भी शुरू नहीं हुआ।
negatives.basis: Nayan Jagriti (page updated 23 Aug 2026): the road to the Thanabhawan cremation ground is waterlogged and muddy in rain; the tender was completed about a year earlier but the contractor has not received a work order. Funeral processions walk through the mud. The article says the EO did not respond to calls.

negatives.english: Wind and rain flattened our ripe paddy and we are worried.
negatives.hindi: तेज हवा और बारिश से हमारी पकी धान की फसल खेत में बिछ गई, हम चिंतित हैं।
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026), Shamli dateline with Thanabhawan included: rain with strong winds flattened standing ripe paddy in fields, and hail was reported in the Thanabhawan area. The Thanabhawan link is only through the dateline and hail mention, so the claim is weakly AC-specific.

negatives.english: Old, damaged 11 kV power lines are causing supply trouble in our villages.
negatives.hindi: जर्जर 11 केवी लाइनों से गांवों में बिजली की दिक्कत बनी हुई है।
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026), Shamli district Kisan Diwas: farmer Kavita Chaudhary asked for dilapidated 11 kV lines to be repaired. This is district-level, not Thanabhawan-specific, and the article does not name the feeder.

notes: Identity: Wikipedia confirms AC 9 Thana Bhawan, general seat, district Shamli (formerly Muzaffarnagar before 2012), Lok Sabha Kairana. Hindi name taken from the Hindi spelling used in local news; not checked against the ECI list. Searches stopped early because the WebSearch budget for this turn was exhausted, so coverage is thin. Several claims I could not verify were dropped: a 13-hour outage in three Thanabhawan mohallas (search found no matching report), and a Thanabhawan power/low-voltage item. An Amar Ujala 12 Oct 2026 item attributes waterlogging from uncleaned drains to Un, not Thanabhawan, so it was not used. Positives 1-4 are inferences flagged as such; no appreciation source for Thanabhawan was found. Field check suggested: Thanabhawan power supply and low voltage, drinking water, stray cattle on roads, the bus stand and bypass works, and the status of the Thanabhawan mill's dues for 2025-26. Negative 4 and 5 are weaker on AC-specific evidence; negatives 1-3 are the strongest local items.
